title: Window switcher
description: Cmd+Tab's shape over the Windows palette: hold the chord to step through the windows, let go to switch; a quick tap goes back to the window before. The chord is the Windows palette's hold. App switcher puts macOS's own switcher on another chord once the switcher has taken cmd+tab.

settings.label: App switcher
settings.description: macOS's own App Switcher (Cmd+Tab's) on another Tab chord, alt+tab, for when the window switcher has taken cmd+tab; its shift+ variant steps back. macOS only.

why: takes cmd+tab from the Dock when that is the chord
